styles.name: GrassPlatform_H1
styles.note: The low raised platform in the middle of the field and the field's own front edge: a face of 11 voxels drawn (rows 180-212 at x 420-460), 1 level.

styles.name: GrassPlatform_H2
styles.note: The tall block at the top right: a face of 23 voxels drawn (rows 72-139 at x 560-600), 2 levels.

styles.name: TrimPlatform_H2
styles.note: The peach path's edge at the right: a band of orange triangles 10 voxels drawn (rows 285-314) over a dark teal wall going on below the frame, 2 levels.

styles.name: EarthCliff_H2
styles.note: The terraced earth cliffs round the village: faces 18 rows drawn from the rim to the dark foot (295-312 at x 352-362), 39 voxels, 2 levels.

styles.name: RedRockCliff_H9
styles.note: The tall red-brown rock at the left edge above the lake: 65 px drawn from the grass rim to the dark foot (y 551-615 at x 20), 141 voxels, 9 levels, the tiers behind it shorter; broken beds of angular blocks 8-12 px drawn, each lit along its top edge (y 552, 562, 569, 579, 594 at x 20).

styles.name: EarthBank_H2
styles.note: The raised earth banks behind the camp: faces 34 art px from the rim to the foot (y 90-192 at x 300 and 450, 3x), 2 levels.

styles.name: SlateLedge_H1
styles.note: The gray slate ledges between the grass terraces: two courses with lit top edges, 17 art px under a 3 px grass rim (y 475-557 at x 960 and 1040, 5x), 1 level.

styles.name: EarthBank_H2
styles.note: The earth banks either side of the waterfall: faces 34 art px from the rim to the foot (y 140-245 at x 560 and 640, 3x), 2 levels; the river pours over them in a sheet with a foam lip and foams at the foot.

styles.name: EarthCliff_H3
styles.note: The orange ledges of the forest paths: faces 17 px drawn from the rim to the foot (y 223-239 at x 104 and 110), 22 voxels at 12.25 px a tile, 3 levels at 0.46; a rounded column a tile, a crease every 12 px (x 95, 107, 119, 131 at y 232). The falls (x 47-82) show light bands across the sheet.

styles.name: CourseCliff_H5
styles.note: The three-course cliffs round the plaza and down the west side: 40 px drawn from under the grass rim to the foot (y 116-155 at x 20 and 26), 87 voxels, 5 levels; each course 16 px, lit along its top and dark at its foot over a gray-green gap, two rounded lumps a tile in line course over course (y 132).

styles.name: BlockCliff_H3
styles.note: The red-brown block cliffs of the gorge and its terraces: each face 23 px drawn from the rim to the foot (y 166-188 and 198-220 at x 330), 50 voxels, 3 levels, a narrow grass ledge (8 px) between terraces; blocks 5-10 px across in rows of 4-11, lit along the top, dark below. The cascades beside them (x 340-456) step down in white foam lines every 16 px.

styles.name: RockLedge_H3
styles.note: The gray crag ledges between the ochre terraces: 21 px drawn from the ochre rim to the dark foot (y 458-478 at x 500), 46 voxels, 3 levels; small rounded chunks in three staggered rows, lit on top, dark below.

styles.name: RockBank_H3
styles.note: The same crag where the ochre ground meets the river: 3 levels down to the water. Its Drain is the arched, barred outfall in the east bank (x 492-516, y 488-502): a ring of pale dressed stone, dark bars.

styles.name: RiverCliff_H6
styles.note: The tall crag walls where the river falls (the islets between the falls and the banks beside them): the falls drop 47 px drawn from the foam lip to the foot (y 430-477 at x 190), 102 voxels, 6 levels; the green sheet shows light bands across it.

styles.name: RetainingWall_H5
styles.note: The masonry wall under the cobbled terrace east of the river: 40 px drawn from the coping to the foot (y 422-461 at x 560 and 600), 87 voxels, 5 levels; a coping of big pale blocks, courses of gray stones with purple-gray and tan ones among them. Its Archway is the arched passage through it (y 440-462).

styles.name: EarthBank_H1
styles.note: The low earth banks along the forest edges: 9 px drawn from the rim to the foot (y 84-92 at x 110 and 116), 20 voxels, 1 level; poke_b's course in one row.

styles.name: LakeBank_H1
styles.note: The same bank where the meadow drops into the lakes, 1 level down to the water.

styles.name: StonyBank_H4
styles.note: The pale stony banks of the terraces round the town: 28 px drawn from the rim to the foot (y 83-110 at x 190), 61 voxels, 4 levels; rounded tan stones in rows, the top row lit, a dark band at the foot.

styles.name: RockLedge_H2
styles.note: The mauve-gray rock ledge running diagonally down the east side to the stairs: 12 px drawn from the grass rim to the dark foot where it runs straight (y 212-223 at x 340), 26 voxels, 2 levels; rounded chunks in two rows. The pond's brown rim is only 3 px (under half a level): the shore tiles of the ground collection cover it.

styles.name: FarmBank_H1
styles.note: The earth banks between the farm's terraces: 10 px drawn from the rim to the foot (y 212-221 at x 80), 22 voxels, 1 level; one course.

styles.name: PondCliff_H3
styles.note: The cliff down to the pond in the southeast: 25 px drawn from the rim to the foot (y 342-366 at x 520 and 540), 54 voxels, 3 levels; two courses, lit along their tops.

styles.name: EarthCliff_H3
styles.note: The orange ledges of the village terraces: 13 px drawn from the rim to the foot (y 288-300 at x 256), 22 voxels at 9.5 px a tile, 3 levels; a rounded column about a tile (creases at x 254, 266, 276 at y 293). Its NarrowFall is the spring falling down the ledge into the small pool above the bridge (x 278-290, 6 px wide).

styles.name: EarthCliff_H3
styles.note: The brown ledges between the village's terraces: 18 px drawn from the rim to the dark foot (y 373-390 at x 470), 24 voxels at 12.25 px a tile, 3 levels; a rounded column a tile (creases every 12 px at y 420).

styles.name: PondBank_H3
styles.note: The same face where it drops to the two ponds: 19 px drawn (y 409-427 at x 400, 397-415 at x 520), 3 levels.

styles.name: EarthCliff_H3
styles.note: The brown ledges stepping down the forest: 23 px drawn from the rim to the dark foot (y 181-203 at x 270), 25 voxels at 14.75 px a tile, 3 levels; a rounded column a tile.

styles.name: LakeBank_H3
styles.note: The same face along the north and west shores of the two lakes, 3 levels down to the water.

styles.name: TerraceBlock_H2
styles.note: The sheet's grass-topped terrace blocks: a wide band of lumpy earth round the grass on top, the face 12 px drawn from the band to the outline at the foot (y 146-157 at x 150), 26 voxels, 2 levels; big rounded lumps lit on top. The mound beside the block is this style's ridge pieces; its gully notch (x 128-160, y 160-176) is the Notch piece.

styles.name: GullyCliff_H3
styles.note: The brown earth ledges of the gully and the river's steps: 26 px drawn from the grass rim to the outline at the foot (y 453-478 at x 420), 52 voxels at 0.5, 3 levels; rounded lumps lit on top. The river spills over them in three places (x 310-360 at y 432-466 the first).

styles.name: RockMountain_H3
styles.note: The lumpy brown rock masses in the top corners: steps of big rounded lumps, the tallest face 25 px drawn from the lit top to the outline (y 7-31 at x 40), 50 voxels at 0.5, 3 levels; their tops the rock itself, lumpy and lit.

styles.name: EarthBank_H1
styles.note: The low mauve-brown banks of the forest terraces on the west side: 4 px drawn (y 368-371 at x 80), 11 voxels at 0.375, 1 level.

styles.name: EarthLedge_H2
styles.note: The taller ledges of the same terraces: 15 px drawn from the lit rim to the dark foot (y 129-143 at x 40), 40 voxels at 0.375, 2 levels.

styles.name: OrangeRock_H5
styles.note: The orange sandstone outcrop in the bottom-left corner: slabs lit along their tops, the top tier's face 28 px drawn (y 593-620 at x 10), 75 voxels at 0.375, 5 levels; the frame cuts off the rest. Its top is the rock itself.

styles.name: PurpleRockPool_H2
styles.note: The purple rock rim of the inland pool at the bottom: 13 px drawn from the grass to the water (y 577-589 at x 470), 35 voxels at 0.375, 2 levels; small rounded stones.

styles.name: GullyWall_H2
styles.note: The gray-brown crag walls of the gully down from the house: 16 px drawn from the grass to the gully's gravel floor (y 95-110 at x 350), 35 voxels, 2 levels, a pale rock rim along the top, deeper parts two such walls a tile apart (y 114-127 at x 270). Its CaveMouth is the cave at the gully's head (x 287-304, y 108-118).

styles.name: ClayTerrace_H3
styles.note: The chunky orange rock between the summit's clay terraces: 24 px drawn from the clay's lit rim to the dark foot (y 180-206 at x 130), 52 voxels, 3 levels; clay above and below.

styles.name: RockTerrace_H3
styles.note: The same rock under the jungle's grass terraces and beside the stairs, 3 levels.

styles.name: CoastalCliff_H5
styles.note: The coastal cliffs down to the beach: tiers of 34-36 px drawn from the grass rim to the dark foot (y 632-667 and 668-701 at x 120; 660-712 at x 180), about 75 voxels, 5 levels; sand at the foot.

styles.name: EarthCliff_H3
styles.note: The terraced ledges north of the village: 16 px of brown face over a 3 px gray stone foot (y 88-106 at x 400), 51 voxels at 0.375, 3 levels; a rounded column a tile (creases every 16 px at y 96).

styles.name: RaisedBed_H1
styles.note: The two raised garden beds in the village: a border of light soil about 5 px wide round the crops, its front about 4 px drawn, 1 level; the bed's top is the garden soil.

styles.name: IslandRim_H3
styles.note: The rim of the floating island: dark gray-brown crags hanging under the grass's edge, 13 px drawn (y 690-702 at x 360), 21 voxels at 10 px a tile, 3 levels, over the island's gray underside; no ground below. The rivers pour off it into the clouds (x 108-140 at y 700-740).

styles.name: Terrace_H2
styles.note: The terraces inside the island: a greenish-gray stone face 7 px drawn under the grass (y 173-179 at x 250), 11 voxels at 10 px a tile, 2 levels. Its CaveMouth is one of the small dark alcoves in these faces (x 220-235, y 165-178); its Fall the rivers stepping down the terraces (x 108-140, y 600-640).

styles.name: CaveWall_H4
styles.note: The cave's warm brown rock walls, stepping round the chamber: 27 px drawn from the rim to the dark outline (y 384-410 at x 60), 59 voxels, 4 levels; big rounded lumps, the cave's rock on top, its sand below. Its CaveMouth is the opening in the east wall (x 928-948, y 430-448).

styles.name: RockPlatform_H4
styles.note: The raised rock platforms inside the cave, topped with the damp dark floor and climbed by stairs: about 28 px drawn (the stairs' rise, y 498-525 at x 190), 61 voxels, 4 levels.

styles.name: IslandRim_H5
styles.note: The rims of the floating islands: two rows of pointed gray crags hanging under the grass, 34 px drawn (y 279-312 at x 100), 78 voxels at 0.4375, 5 levels; no ground below. Its NarrowFall is the narrow ribbon of water off an island's edge, clipped by the frame in the art, so reconstructed.
